function.name: get_lawsuit_details
function.description: Retrieve the detailed information about a lawsuit based on its case number and the court location.

case_number.description: The case number of the lawsuit.

court_location.description: The location of the court where the case is filed.

additional_details.description: Optional. Array containing additional details to be fetched. Default is empty array.

function.name: get_team_rank
function.description: Get the team ranking in a sports league based on season and type.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The name of the league in which the team competes.

season.description: The season for which the team's ranking is sought.

type.description: Type of the season: regular or playoff.

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.
